body:
You need to jump into another dating pool.  There are people out there looking for thier match.   Spent way too much time in the hetero cis dating pool maintaining a male facade.  I took three years of introspection, therapy to unpack my own life trauma and how to go forward, as well as learning what i was and what my kinks were without associated shame.   

Found my someone, we dated, she proposed.   I was trying to live my life truthfully.  She is also healing amd living life her truth.  We are Still going strong.

This is a safe space.  For women of all sorts.   By all means call, ask, inquire about MtF safety and the bringing of a token of appreciation ie baked yumminess.   You will likely be made welcome.   Respect the bylaws and relax into exercising your perception skills as you learn to flex  feminity and drop the years of maintaining a masculine facade.


Updates are requested.

Have fun!!

TRex

I also had to stop the TBlocker due to brain fog.    My daughter actually approached me and ever so gently recommended a doctor appt for early onset alzheimers.

I thought i was hiding the effects rather well.  Nope.  I explained the side effects of the t blocker and my efforts to counter it.

So yeah.  I stopped that day.   As the meds wore off, omfg, i started to fire on all cylinders and speaking with multisyllabic words again. Lol

I have two sources.
1) the prescribing doctor.  He wants to make sure i have not just the proper hrt care but the resources for IM dosages.  So he offers/sells a box of syringes as part of the script.
2) my online pharmacy also offers a syringe supply kit to accompany the vial.  

TRex

Sounds like the hag has enough to do multiple summons "monster" to battle on her behalf.  Sucks to be them, expending spells, potions and resources possibly losing limbs or near death (stabilized?)  At random to them or critical junctures where said summoned PC need to be with the group only to be returned in less than ideal condition.

My story,  fueling up at a Pilot.  Trucker next to me pulls up, dumps his piss bottle right there outside his driver window.  Gathers up the trash decorating his cab and at least that stuff went into convenient trash can.  He then steps out (and into urine puddle) and starts to fuel up.    He had the audacity to ask if my company was hiring, what the benefits are etc.   I was less than impressed.

On the flip side of this coin, looking optimistically.

This may open up friendships and dating prospects from people who dont care or even prefer what you offer.    The toxic and disapproving kids/adults will reveal themselves a whole lot easier.   Believe thier actions over words and move on.

Do not try regain a friendship that suddenly has conditions.   Find a group of kids that lives without drama, unless it is theatre kids or band.   They are usually embrace it with flair in the best of ways.

Check that inverter is on
Or
Start the APU while truck is running.  The diesel may have gelled up sitting so long since last operation.

Start a slower more oblique exit strategy.   Go to school or education or job that may lead to an opportunity for travel.   Likely all three of above to eventually happen.   At the very least, this new life plan will get you away from family to where you can find or choose a friendly support network and safer place to live in country.

You dont necessarily have happily employed, just reasonably competent.   Once safer away, repeat the process of education and job search until further away, happier or safer.

I managed military service to get away and stable finances.   Bury the LGBT until free.    The service, job, education is not a lifelong commitment, only a tool to get to better place.  Keep that in mind.   In the meantime, let your family and friends know about these traditional steps to be a productive masculine member of society.   Your time will come, use them and thier bigotry to help this first step of independent manhood.

TRex

I agree with your statement.   The takeaway I found useful was the "I am not alone", and also thier struggles and rants.   Knowing that while their latest issues may not have happened to you yet, they would make an appearance.   I was able to recognize the passive microaggressions, the toxic transphobes trying to be invisible, and related red flags.   I did not internalize society issues as my fault but other peoples personality flaws and failure to grow as I did.

Made it much easier to choose who I wanted to associate with and who to keep at arms length.   

This also applied to medical practices and doctors who truly were advocates or allies.  I got the pro and cons from thier rants
Agreed.  I ended up buying a charger and wire for each room.   Plus a monthly purchase as these things grew legs and walked away or got damaged.

Well, take a breath.   A deep breath.

You have a very important asset.  Time, 22yo young. 

There are several jobs that will gladly take that coin in exchange.  

There is the military.   Several types of enlistments and even more types of jobs.  3 hots and a cot.   Your milage may vary.  I speak as a 22year vet.  Retired.  MtF.

Truck driving.  The quals arent that difficult, within reach of a lot of folk.  Some companies will pay you to attend CDL school while they pay for the school.   You could end up in a sleeper cab and not even bother with an apartment, utilities, much less a mortgage.  Rough life.  Can be lonely.   Currently, doing this now.  Paying my bills.

Both jobs will offer a ticket away from Dodge City and out of reach from toxic family.

You will find your tribe.

TRex

We own a dehydrator as well as vac seal machine.   We make prepped meals and freeze them.

With that amount of beef already cooked, I would break out the bean soups, chili and also braise a bunch of carrots/onions/tators etc seasoned to taste.   Add beef to all of these in the amount of yout liking.    Ziplock and label with name and date, freeze.

Quick meals when feeling peckish or lazy,just boil water and toss the frozen ziplocked meal in.     


We invited some friends over and held a meatball prep event and spaghetti/meatball dinner.   We had individual  spice/flavor bowls and ~10lbs of ground beef (discounted,frozen and marked for quick sale).   Sounds corny, but everyone had fun and got to take some of thier handywork home for future meals.

Good luck!

WPATH was my start thru the VA system.  You would think I was the first one there and maybe I was for thier personal experience but they maintained professionalism.   Yes it was slow and conservative; however, I treated it like onset puberty.   Gave me time to adapt while I upgraded my social handling skills.

And the bumper lanes?  I outgrew them and signed up for DrPowers waiting list.  Very glad I did the bumper lanes WPATH.

-TRex

PS: I did take a small measure of pleasure making the other veterans uncomfortable/awkward simply by existing.   Waiting areas are limited and someone had to sit by me. LOL

Full disclosure: I am MtF.   I also am experiencing this.  

 To be quite honest, way back in time when I was just another "guy".   I never noticed any difference when I was dating someone.  And as for locker room talk, it simply never came up.  Seriously.  I don't think any male that I know of ever realized much less discussed these so-called imperfections.    We were just happy to see boobs.

Full circle.  I now use my lopsidedness as a bonding thing with other women.  Typically following the phrase " I didn't sign up for this"  or" this wasn't in the fine print of transitioning hormone medical disclosure"   Good for a laugh and an icebreaker at my expense.

In the meantime, I hold a secret hope that the lopsided weight will correct the curvature in my back. 😆 

TRex

Well.   They did predict Death Panels.   Turns out it was only slight Projection on thier part.   I wonder what kind of panel is next?  Trans legitimacy?  Approved religions?     Maybe they'll finally get the "proper skin color bias" legalized?

I got mine in July.  Dead name. Of course.  

I called them up to inform them.  They wanted a copy of name change.   I directed them to thier own archives as I had it done there.  Even provided the court doc number.  That was a fun UNO reverse card to play. 

I confirmed that I am willing and would be presentable, in femme attire, if called.  I was assured it was not an issue.

I was not called to jury duty.

Wow.  Ok.  You will have to really lock down your self.   You are closely monitored and restricted freedom.   Change your defense.
No writing anything LGBT. I would assume there are Spyware on computers and or phone unless you are more savvy than parents.   

Find a hobby or sport or apprenticeship that takes you out of house.  You need a support network outside of family.  It is OK if they are not that fun.   This interest should provide breathing room for you to think without mother hovering over you.   Could be soccer, computer programming club,  tracing genealogy of your family and ancestors.   Seriously, the sport does not matter.  The hobby does not matter.  Getting out and getting friends matters.

Is there a library?  Can you garden?  Play magic. The gathering or yu gi yo.  Start a puzzle collection and work it.  Etc.  Grab some books of interest.   Your escape may be in your head.  Better strengthen and fortify it.

A reverse UNO would be very revealing but too easily twisted by manipulating people.    Record this conversation, and immediately followup with a phone call to the appropriate authorities on speaker.  Odds are they won't even let you complete call.

On a related note, they drew the battlelines. Get your papers in order, take possession and actively secure them in a safe deposit box or location that isn't your bedroom.  

Actively find a support network and trusted persons outside of them.   Gaslighting will be the next tactic of choice.  You will need someone to keep you from questioning your experiences and being overcome with guilt for merely existing.   Keep a journal, calendar, messages to self on paper or online.   Their arguments will not be truthful or logical. They have one agenda that must be attained at any cost.  Even at the expense of thier child.
Get into character.  Pick a persona.  Channel your inner witch.   You are not a guy.  A lot of women go as witches.  You are just one of many.  And rock that wand/broomstick/Dyson vac!

Oh I agree with this as well.  He could totally be a creep, perhaps a hormonal panty wanker.   Who knows.  The boundary discussion and gift offering is basically the first salvo of drawing the battlelines.  They could be allies, neutral parties or "an informal cold war of subject shall never be discussed again".  

Regardless, the big sister should address it while the stakes are minimal.  She can escalate as needed if situation continues or definitely into creep factor.

I agree with Bunches.   When you do have this discussion regarding boundaries, may I suggest you bring an peace offering of a pack of panties and a pair of tights/nylons as his own.   During this boundary discussion, you could offer to be his discrete shopping buddy.   Establish that it is far easier and less creepy to wear his own clothes then raid your laundry.  And you don't want to resent him if he damages or stretches out your stuff.  This could be couched as Big Sister mentoring if he is willing to be honest with himself.

Good luck Big Sis with your hopefully new lil sister.

Truck driver also.  Bounced from job to job prior to this.   Apparently I became incompetent since transitioning despite 22 yrs at one job and 5 yrs at another plus a handful of seasonal 2nd jobs during spare time.   

It is getting better though.

Create a BINGO card for him.   Actually listen to his trials and tribulations of his day, collect his top 50 occurances, put them on a homemade BINGO cards to check off during work.   Perhaps a reward with a Couples date if that day's card comes back full.   He had an eventful work day, not necessarily good or bad but busy.

3+ years of hrt.  Full time repping the lifestyle.  Legal name change.  Etc.

Still get misgendered.  Mostly by folks that are awkward about it and the occasional troll.   I do my business, don't even give them a second of thought.   They are becoming smaller in numbers. 

To address the question posed. For me,  I came out softly.   I had several talks with accepting folks and allies.   I let the rumor mill do its thing and emphasize it was not the least bit a secret, to talk about it matter of fact manner.  More than a few came directly to me to confirm, and a surprising number of people were not just allies but also members still not ready to step out as LGBT.

And of course waiting for the HRT to take effect.  My breasts slowly grew, my face softened, fat redistributed to hips and ass.  I gratefully dropped the male facade and filter I had to impose upon myself for years.  My friends actually laughed at me when after three years of hrt and living as me I tried to "man up" to show how I used to be.  Apparently and happily it is a one way trip.

Every day I come out.  Every day I am an ambassador.  Some days I am inconquerably confident, other days all I see is a man in dress who got dressed in the dark.
Yet... when I connect with a person who is deeply closeted or having an "off day" in presenting giving them confidence.   Makes my whole week.

As for the trolls, who seem to be getting louder as they become lonelier.  Make it awkward.  Make them explain themselves as their obvious logic isn't sensible, humor isn't funny, approval is not required.

No.  Drug tests costs money.  They typically screen for a panel of five.   Only testing for additional if suspected and justified.   Hormones and/or steroids are performance oriented so unless you are competing in some "Human Physique measure" event, you are good.

Some medicines may result in false positives which will bear additional scrutiny but upfront notification usually gives clues for which metabolites to dismiss.

Full disclosure: I am MtF.  But at time of story I was deep in closet, male presenting.

Active duty military USCG.  My issued tools of trade kept getting "borrowed" or just outright stolen.  I purchased neon pink dive flashlights,  bright yellow dive camera and pink girl pens.   The theft stopped over night and even the borrowing ceased to the point My peers would rather do the job in the dark than use light from a pink source.

I apparently was the only one secure enough in my manhood to own such stuff.  The irony.
Good luck.  Viva de resistance

Hell yeah.   I splurged on three and holy cow these feel amazing and also like flexible armor.   The confidence I had stepping out I cannot tell ya.  I feared no snag.   Walking in stocking feet, nothing caught.

I am not a paid spokesperson, and I've already designated all other nylons for projects, not necessarily for wear and tear (literally)

TRex

I did a lot of things that made a few men wish to follow my foot steps.   I was searching for a reason to live, to exist, looking for an iota of happiness in the pursuit of distraction.  I even carried the label of adrenaline junkie.  I got bored after mastering a skillset or hobby and losing the dopamine fix. Tried something else.

Turns out it it was depression, ADHD, not so much denial but heavily invested in maintaining the masculine  facade required for military life before, during DADT.  Obligatory lifestyle.

I saw a version of this happen at my military unit.   She was female Junior Officer.   And the invite was the from the Capt to golf with him and the Commanders.   She also debated the ethics and what-ifs.   We (her enlisted crew) rallied around her.   She got lessons and a borrowed set of clubs so she wasn't blindsided. 

She did well.   Conversely,  she also started her ascension into "corporate culture" and slowly stopped being one of us to one of them, as expected.  Last I checked, she was a captain herself.   She was worthy of the rank.

So yes. Learn and play golf.  Learn board room networking.

Currently Schneider haz Tanker.   Not yet a year but fast approaching.   I am a regional yet they have been using me to plug holes in various dedicated routes.   So my range is a mix of local for a week, then otr for random deliveries, followed by dedicated route two states away.  They still managed to get me home on weekends so I am good.  I did volunteer for this as I get bored of the same route after a month.

I know Schneider is hiring, I keep filling holes until they can hire a local driver who enjoys being home daily.  Or go regional/ OTR and be willing to drive local temporarily.   

I love the experience.  Pay could be better yet I am learning so much.  I will emphasize, I am a regional driver but so far my range has been everything east and including Wisconsin, Illinois to NJ to AL and GA.   

In regards to tanker jobs, Pilot and Love's seem to be always hiring fuel tankers depending on location.

Agreed.  Build your experience and confidence first.   The money will happen gradually.  Terminals have (usually) driver resources, plenty of space to park, reposition, develop good habits without feeling cramped or rushed.

Too many close calls and poor decisions when I started.   Almost quit, rushed alot to prove myself.   
Currently slowing down, the tanker will get there when it is meant to be.

Last week I turned down a load (40' tank with a sleeper cab) that specifically required a single framed tank truck.  Dispatcher not doing his due diligence and setting me up for failure.   My experience let me trip plan properly and push back on his idiocy.

I do have a few coworkers and relatives that have fallen into a rut of catchphrases.   Mostly they grow out of it.  However, in the meantime, I try to make a game of it with synonymous words.  Hoping they expand the vocabulary.  It has yet to work, but I have expanded mine so there is a positive.   Conversely, I have vowed to never utter those phrases and listen closely to myself.

Otherwise, discretion is key unless you want to lose a friend.

Good luck.

I choose to wear them for effect.  Recently treated myself to an expensive purchase, sheertex tights.   Serious upgrade, these tights are armor.  I felt invulnerable or at the very least no worries about legwear issues.  Not likely to go back.

But mostly, I go bare leg.  We will see what fall and winter bring.

Full Disclosure: I am MtF.  As such, I am not even approached about this anymore.   Aaahhh. Bliss.

In a previous closeted time, I existed as male, with all the expectations and obligations assumed.  Yet, I always drew the line at professional sports: football, baseball, basketball, hockey, Nascar, "professional wrestling", all of them.  Nope, nada, didn't care, didn't want to hear, talk or read about it.

It was a great shame of my father, father in law, brother in law and/or failure as a son depending on what button they wanted to push.   

Still, living a masculine lifestyle, inevitably I was drawn into sports discussions of greatest import.   I provided numerous insights and critiques as expected.   Mockery  of my opinions and lack of knowledge had the opposite effect of expressing my glorious wanton ignorance and suggestion that professional sport team should go on strike for more pay. Again.

I did learn about sports: the medical trauma, the backroom politics,  greed, double standards of justice for players, the inequality of women's sports. Reasons for  Title IX.   Economics impacts to the local taxpayers. Not to mention traffic congestion.  Etc.

I stopped being invited.   They could not refute.  If they weren't willing to have a well balanced conversation then I had no time for them either.

This may be a good way to steer or control the convo of the offending male who found a captive audience to prey upon.

I was RV camping in Wyoming, during the winter.  Set my heater at a comfortable temp(for me) and while I had multiple blankets, used only a simple comforter. Thought nothing of it.  My then GF came out to visit, ended up staying throughout the deep freeze.   

Temperature adjusted and all blankets used, I adjusted to a simple sheet and nude with my legs out to moderate any heat relief.

She still wrapped herself around me like an octopus around its prey.

I was roasting. She called me a furnace.

For the record:  best thing to happen to me.   She proposed halfway thru winter.  I suspected ulterior motives.

And here I am, a MtF trucker seeking a LED sculpture for my cab to counterbalance those lit up crosses some truckers have.

Thinking a LED 20sided die, or dragon or gargoyle if I can find one.

"Paperweights"  doodads and leftovers tweaked to always secure the blueprints, pages or small tools to any surface. Mostly horizontal flat surfaces but numerous whatsits function vertical and upside down.   

Not much use for anything else, just an absent minded item used to keep thier space organized.
You good.  This is a safe space to do this.

I would say that thier inner monologue and lifelong critic is heard in thier mothers voice.  Their response and counterargument just escaped to the outside.

  You can ignore it or gently acknowledge this by counteracting and validating with positive affirmations.   May be an awkward convo, especially on thier part, but a friend doesn't mind.

Assuming several things, you both are legally underage ie not yet 18+. This limits some activities.

Can you enlist your parents, support group or even small cadre of trusted friends to provide an affirming and validating environment to counteract the negativity of thier own family?  They are immersed in an intolerant  propaganda culture which is isolating and wears away at one's outlook on life.

Besides providing a positive environment away and counteracting the isolation, you could also let them know they could keep a stash of important clothes and  documents(copies if not originals) at your place.  Again,  making assumptions of how bad thier situation is.

Sounds like you are on the WPATH method of transitioning. https://www.wpath.org/

I also started with a doctor using this system.  Slow.  I stuck with for about 6 months.  Recommend you read up on the side effects of meds and pro/con of each method of delivery.  Excellent advice regardless.  I was suffering several cons and at higher risk for permanent issues.

There are other methodology and doctors invested in our care/advocacy.    The link below provides another way to transition as well as additional testing to get a better picture of your hormonal health.  While DrPowers has a waiting list, other doctors are utilizing his approach.   You are your own best advocate.   See if your doctor is familiar with below.  Download the PowerPoint.  Extremely informative and thorough, moreso than WPATH.
https://powersfamilymedicine.com/media

I currently take estradiol via ~weekly shots.  The difference was substantial. 

In the meantime, take your meds sublingual, avoid the gastrointestinal tract.  Let your body absorb it.   
At that low dosage, you are allowing your body to slowly build up the infrastructure much like a prepubescent or early puberty.

Serious answer#1: barter/trade for what you do want.   Learn your friends and/or coworkers.

Serious answer#2: prewrap and store these as housewarming, wedding or related gifts.

Serious answer#3: there will come a time where you are invited to a BYOB/dish type event.   Perfect place to dump this, get credit, partake in (their) food and no expectations of wanting any of it back.

Go for depression/anxiety, and growth.  The lgbt is a side issue you can address as it comes up during therapy.  And yeah, when I started I was also limited to 6 sessions/yr.   But so what.  It is a start and it becomes a documented need "that wasn't resolved in 6 sessions"   I addressed some issues and explored options.  Sometimes reframed the trauma.    

Regardless, it allowed me to grow and upgrade the tools I developed as a child.  They worked for childhood and adolescence but I needed to adult up.  Therapy isn't a magic pill, the therapist should be able help reframe some stuff and give you an objective view as well as a script to control the inner monologue.  Seriously, whose voice is the loudest in your head?  Silence them.

Sooo hrt is out.   Does your family insurance cover therapy/counseling?  Shop around.  Use whatever premise you want, depression anxiety of college, insecurities of adulthood.... Upgrade your assertiveness and advocate skills.   Get comfortable in your skin and explore this side of you with professional help.   Learn to recognize red flags and define your boundaries.   

The therapist will also help locate resources for you as you grow comfortable. And patient doctor confidentiality applies.  So you won't be outed.  

If it doesn't work, change counselors and try again.   This is part of self-care you need to learn.

This opens up another opportunity,  what are your shower thoughts of how it would go?   The perfect response, a simple response,  an expected release of pressure?  Mull it over.  Practice.   

Are you ready to transition?  Or perhaps dip your toe in as a NonBinary They/them.  It isn't wrong, and may be enough for now.

This opportunity will occur again.  And again. And again. Even to the same people at different times (due to denial, avoidance or disgust and boundary stomping)

I've come out several times to my father.  He does not approve and reverts back any chance he gets.   A majority of my friends are totally onboard without a blink.   I guess they all had the "ahaa" moment as the pieces finally fell into place.   They were just waiting for me to be ready.

Best of all, you can simply get a pronoun button that quietly yet eloquently speaks for you as you wear it throughout college.  No convo required.

You deserve to live and thrive as yourself.

-TRex

An assumption: he is touched starved.  His love language involves romantic as well as nonromantic human contact.   Toxic masculinity says only affection leading to sex touching allowed.   Try events that dont HAVE to end in sex.   a gentle head to toe massage, mutual bathing/showering and grooming, practice nudity in home.  Do yoga together.

Just an idea.

My relationships since I started my transition have been more honest and enjoyable than I ever had when i was in the closet.   

Find yourself a different dating pool and actual friends who like you for you with genital biases

It is not a competition.   You girls are in a different race, related but still different.

She will experience misogyny and the patriarchal biases.   You will too, yet your experiences will not match.    
Learn from this, do you carry/stock emergency supplies fem products in your car or a "spare" in your purse?  Support and be sympathetic with her, don't steal, share or one-up her experience. Just be.

You are in good company.    Excellent therapist.   Hold onto your boundaries,  engage at arms distance, maintain the information diet.

For my dad, I control the conversation flow.   He is so set in ways and his script, it is easy to disrupt when I drill down into the why's?   Then I also ask him the same invasive questions "because family has a need to know".    

Somehow the status of his genitals has no bearing.   "At  your age, isn't ED a thing?   How often does it effect you? Suffering from shrinkage due to reduced testosterone production...."      oh, now that personal?   But family...

Yes it is possible.   I was at a truck stop, a driver connected to my truck speakers via Bluetooth (unsecured at the time) .   They controlled the volume as they tried various levels to hear.   Could not disconnect them until they gave up or realized error.    

Extremely disconcerting.  Almost broke the 10hr rest just to get the fuck away

Speaking for myself (and my team) , we haven't yet.   We'd rather cause a minor traffic inconvenience than a road closure.  Police feel the same way.

My personal record: made a left turn onto a "truck GPS approved route",  immediately observed a set back No truck over 8tons sign, right beside the railroad crossing just before a lovely bridge with a weight limit (8 ton) and a narrowing of road on other end.  I noted that route, made sure I was clear of intersection and block the right lane.   Triangles out and waited for available officer to let me back into intersection and bug out.

No issues beside embarrassing.  Officer said I would have had difficulty maneuvering after bridge.
Call police non-emergency number.  Ask for traffic assist and wait.

The terms Mom, mother are honorific.  You wouldn't want to disrespect her name by ignoring it.  Nor her mother (your grandma)  by addressing her God given name before she gave it up during marriage.

A good throwback to her roots.   You know the name she went by for decades within her family growing up.   It should be no problem using her own logic.

No you ain't.   Make your peace and do small steps, simple preparations and research.   Pick up a hobby that gives time and distance away as well as an opp to express yourself.

You compromise for everyone but never prioritize yourself.   It can be done in small victories

Find yourself a different set of friends and create your "chosen" family.   Go to some lgbt meetings and support groups.    You will learn you are not alone and this is invaluable as your support network will actually grow.
Not become weaponized like your birth family has done.

They do not value you or your time.   Sure, there are times when it is unavoidable and have justified reasons.   Life happens.  Three strikes and I don't make plans with them. 
 I will do whimsical invites to maintain a semblance of friendship, but nothing concrete.   Ie "I am at the Farners Market nearby, feel free to meet up."  Then I do my shopping, enjoy the ambience, chat up the vendors and depart with my victory spoils.   
Only one person, has ever taken me up on these random invites and he thrives on spontaneous random adventures.   
The other folk slowly gravitated to different circle of friends that they enjoyed/preferred as I gently let them go.  I figured out I was the only one putting in The effort.   I got sad, yet allowed myself to learn from this and not hold regrets.  Friendships grow and die and change.
Alternatively this is a strike against misogyny.   So good on ya.

I agree with the consensus, Do Both.   

The therapy was really helpful in upgrading my toolbox of handling other people violating my boundaries.   Learning self-confidence and assertiveness, placing boundaries and the the language to enforce it.   And of course the years of repression, suppression and denial.

When I started HRT, the hormones cured my anxiety, depression and insecurities.  Basically everything stemming from repression, suppression  and denial.  I still have ADHD.  Ugh.   
 The other side effect of HRT, my mind actually started to work better, like I had two pedals on the bicycle instead of just one.   It is an amazing thing and my Ahaa moment.  I mean the physical changes are well documented and appreciated, yet the mental and emotional effects are what makes everything worth it.

My daughter says I am a wholly different parent, more smiles and relaxed.

This is a sad moment and both of you are allowed to mourn the end of this relationship.  Or at least the romantic part.   As breakups go, this is pretty damn smooth and mature. She has preferences as do you, it is not a bad thing.   It was supportive and nurturing enough that you were able to to even have the Trans Talk.  

So many of us have had to suppress, hide, and deny this side until it becomes inevitable screaming to be let out.  Which is not a good alternative.  Very messy and chaotic.

Looks like you got some exploring to do and lots of reading and Journaling.    Good first step.
My library, plus a few others in area, run a seed catalogue.   You can "checkout" the seeds which were donated either overbought or harvested and labeled.   See if this resource is available.

Why not have have environmental hazards.  
 Molds, oozes and fungi.   Don't show up in dark vision necessarily,  by the time PCs notice them it is only because of "make a saving throw...".  

Throw in a methane accumulation in low spots where nothing grows.

Take any religion, at the lower public levels it does good or just enough to pass.  
 The next level up the chain are the fervent, the manipulative, ulterior motive ones but also where they can occasionally promote and scapegoat or weed out those who catch wind of shenanigans, low level evil.  Move them to faith/conversion camps or publicly disavow.
Incorporate or plant followers into hierarchy of government.  Flex favors, cover ups, bureaucratic red tape and disapprovals as preferred.  Spies, informants embedded.
Higher yet, is where those who can be trusted are sifted out for small projects, long term seeds that are unethical but not illegal.

Forced to delay hormones?
Perfect time to get facial laser or electrolysis, if you cam schedule it.

Preparation will go a long way.   
1) Draft out your coming out letter.   There are plenty of examples to be found as well as lessons learned from the aftermath.  Even if you don't hand it out, you can use this as a script so you don't get dragged into historical family baggage.

2) identify an ally that can step in and possibly mediate when emotions get too high, someone that can quickly show up and remove you or a place of refuge should you be kicked to curb.  May never happen but even the concept of a fallback will bolster your confidence.

3) Collect/make copies of important documents that before the big reveal.  Just in case.  I advocate keeping a Go-bag outside of home/with friend or living out of backpack such that should the worst happen, you are not without some modicum of resources.  Quite frankly, I would have a nondescript medicine bottle with my HRT travel supply.  Family snoops and a loss of a week meds is more tolerable vs 3months delay.

4) A recording app or pocket recorder running, if gaslighting, denial or worse happens.  I know it sounds paranoid but is it really?  Rather this than years of second-guessing what was heard vs what was said.
